title: Privacy Policy — Khalid Farhan | Khalid Farhan
metaDesc: Privacy policy for khalidfarhan.com. How we collect, use, and protect your data.

blocks.text: This website is operated by Khalid Farhan (trading as khalidfarhan.com), a digital marketing agency based in Dublin, Ireland. Our registered email is khalid@khalidfarhan.com.
We may collect the following types of personal data:

items.text: Contact information: Name, email address, phone number — when you submit a contact form, book an audit, or purchase a product.
Payment information: Processed by Stripe (international) or SSLCommerz (Bangladesh). We do not store card details.
Usage data: Pages visited, time on site, and referring URLs via Google Analytics 4. This data is anonymised.
Cookie data: See our Cookie Policy for details.
To fulfil orders and process payments
To send order confirmations and receipts
To respond to enquiries and support requests
To send marketing emails (with your consent, opt-out available in every email)
To improve our website and services through analytics

blocks.text: For users in the EU/EEA, we process data based on: (1) contract performance — to deliver services you’ve purchased; (2) legitimate interest — to improve our services and communicate with clients; (3) consent — for marketing communications.
We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with:

items.text: Payment processors (Stripe, SSLCommerz) for transaction processing
Email service providers (Resend) for transactional and marketing emails
Analytics tools (Google Analytics 4) — data is anonymised
For Yapcorder only: DigitalOcean (recording storage), LiveKit (live calls), Neon (database) and Vercel (hosting)

blocks.text: We retain customer data for 7 years for accounting and legal purposes. Marketing consent data is retained until you withdraw consent.
Yapcorder, at khalidfarhan.com/yapcorder, records podcasts and calls. When you use it, as a subscriber (the host) or as a guest, this is what happens to your data:

items.text: Recordings: video and audio of each person in a session, recorded on that person’s own device. The recording is kept on the device only until it has uploaded, then removed from the device.
Account data: the host’s email address, the name each person types when joining, and session titles.
Technical data: browser type and upload status for each file, used only to make recordings reliable and to fix problems.
Who can see recordings: only the host who created the session. Guests are told before joining that the session is recorded and shared with the host.

Where it is stored: recordings in DigitalOcean Spaces storage in Amsterdam, in the EU; account data in a Neon database; the app is hosted on Vercel; live calls pass through LiveKit and are not recorded by LiveKit.

How long we keep recordings: 7 days on the Starter plan and 30 days on the Pro plan after a recording finishes, then they are deleted automatically. Account and billing records follow the retention rules below.
Hosts are responsible for telling their guests they are being recorded and for having their agreement, as the law where they record requires.

blocks.text: Under GDPR, you have the right to: access your data, correct inaccurate data, request deletion, restrict processing, and object to processing. Email khalid@khalidfarhan.com to exercise any of these rights.
See our Cookie Policy for full details.
